citizen_docs.title: Your documents
citizen_docs.intro: What this application needs, and where each item stands. Nothing here blocks your application: the agency checks the rest at the venue.
citizen_docs.error: We could not load your documents. Try again in a moment.
citizen_docs.all_done: Everything the registries can check is done.

sat.AWAITING_NESA: NESA has not published these results yet. We will check again by ourselves; you do not need to do anything.
sat.UNDER_REVIEW: An officer is looking at it
sat.REJECTED: Not accepted. Please contact the agency.

type.MEDICAL_CERTIFICATE_GOVT: Medical certificate from a government doctor
type.APPLICATION_FORM_WITH_PHOTO: Application form with a passport photo

clearance.field_label: Application number of your criminal-record certificate
clearance.hint: Request the certificate on IremboGov, then type its application number here: a letter, 12 digits and 4 letters.
clearance.shape: This number is not in the right shape: a letter, 12 digits and 4 letters.
clearance.sent: Number received. We are checking it.
clearance.closed: This application is closed, so a number can no longer be added.
clearance.failed: We could not send the number. Try again.

state.NUMBER_REQUIRED: We still need the number of your criminal-record certificate.
state.VERIFYING: We are checking your certificate. This can take a few minutes; you do not need to do anything.
state.UNDER_OFFICER_REVIEW: An officer will look at your certificate. You do not need to do anything.

code.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER_MALFORMED: The number is not in the right shape. Check it and try again.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND: We could not find a certificate with this number. Check the number and try again.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_BOUND: This record does not match your identity. Check that you typed the number of your own certificate.
code.CERTIFICATE_WRONG_TYPE: This is not a criminal-record certificate. Request the right certificate on IremboGov and give its number.
code.CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED: This certificate is too old or not yet valid. Request a new one on IremboGov.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID: This certificate is no longer valid. Request a new one on IremboGov.
code.DEFAULT: We could not accept this certificate. Check the number and try again.

apply.nida_title: Your details, as recorded by NIDA
apply.nida_body: These details come from the national identity record. You cannot change them here. If something is wrong, it must be corrected with NIDA.
apply.nida_unavailable: We could not show your NIDA details right now. You can continue; your application is checked against NIDA in any case.
apply.nida_asked: NIDA does not give us this, so you will be asked for it
